MEDICAL DIRECTOR AGREEMENT

This Medical Director Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into as of October 1, 2026 (the "Effective Date") by and between Ridgeline Community Hospital, an Ohio nonprofit corporation ("Hospital"), and Amara Osei, M.D., an individual licensed to practice medicine in the State of Ohio ("Medical Director").

RECITALS

Hospital operates a cardiovascular service line and requires the administrative and clinical oversight of a qualified physician. Medical Director is board certified in cardiovascular disease and is qualified to provide the services described below. The parties intend that this Agreement comply with the physician self-referral law, 42 U.S.C. § 1395nn, and its personal service arrangements exception at 42 C.F.R. § 411.357(d), and with the personal services and management contracts safe harbor to the federal Anti-Kickback Statute at 42 C.F.R. § 1001.952(d).

1. Engagement and Duties.

Hospital engages Medical Director to serve as Medical Director of the cardiovascular service line. Medical Director shall: (a) supervise and coordinate the clinical activities of the service line; (b) develop, review, and update clinical protocols and order sets; (c) participate in quality-improvement, peer-review, and utilization-review activities; (d) assist in the development of the service line's annual budget and strategic plan; (e) serve as liaison between the service line and the medical staff; and (f) attend the meetings described in Section 3.

2. Time Commitment.

Medical Director shall devote an average of twenty (20) hours per month to the Services, not to exceed two hundred forty (240) hours per year. The Services are set out with specificity in Exhibit A, which the parties acknowledge covers all of the services to be provided.

3. Time Records.

Medical Director shall maintain and submit to Hospital a monthly time log recording, for each date of service, the time expended, the specific administrative task performed, and the deliverable produced. Hospital shall pay only for hours documented in an approved time log. Time logs are retained by Hospital for six (6) years.

4. Compensation.

Hospital shall pay Medical Director $220 per documented hour, payable monthly in arrears within thirty (30) days after receipt of an approved time log. The parties have determined this rate to be consistent with fair market value for the Services, based on the 2026 SullivanCotter Physician Compensation Survey for cardiovascular medical directorships in the Midwest region, a copy of the supporting analysis being retained in Hospital's files. Aggregate compensation shall not exceed $52,800 in any twelve-month period.

5. Compensation Not Based on Referrals.

The compensation set out in Section 4 was determined in advance, is set in advance for the entire term, does not exceed fair market value, and does not take into account, directly or indirectly, the volume or value of any referrals or other business generated between the parties. Nothing in this Agreement requires Medical Director to refer any patient to Hospital or to any affiliate of Hospital, and Medical Director's compensation will not be adjusted based on any referral.

6. Commercial Reasonableness.

The parties acknowledge that the Services are reasonable and necessary for the legitimate business purposes of Hospital and would be commercially reasonable even if no referrals were made between the parties.

7. Term.

The term of this Agreement is three (3) years commencing on the Effective Date, unless earlier terminated under Section 8. If this Agreement is terminated with or without cause during its term, the parties may not enter into a new arrangement for the same services on different terms during the first year of the original term.

8. Termination.

Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause on ninety (90) days' prior written notice. Hospital may terminate immediately upon: (a) suspension, revocation, or restriction of Medical Director's license or DEA registration; (b) loss of medical staff membership or clinical privileges at Hospital; (c) exclusion, debarment, or suspension from any federal health care program; or (d) failure to maintain the insurance required by Section 10.

9. Exclusivity of Duties; No Duplication.

The Services do not duplicate services Medical Director provides under any other arrangement with Hospital or its affiliates, and Medical Director shall not bill any third-party payer for the Services.

10. Insurance.

Medical Director shall maintain professional liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $3,000,000 in the aggregate, and shall provide Hospital with a certificate of insurance on request. Medical Director shall maintain tail coverage or an extended reporting endorsement upon termination.

11. Independent Contractor.

Medical Director is an independent contractor and not an employee of Hospital. Medical Director is responsible for all federal, state, and local taxes on the compensation paid under this Agreement, and Hospital will report the compensation on IRS Form 1099.

12. Confidentiality; HIPAA.

Medical Director shall comply with all Hospital policies concerning the confidentiality of patient information and shall execute Hospital's business associate agreement to the extent required by 45 C.F.R. Parts 160 and 164.

13. Records and Access.

Until the expiration of four (4) years after the furnishing of the Services, Medical Director shall, upon written request of the Secretary of Health and Human Services or the Comptroller General, make available the contracts, books, documents, and records necessary to verify the nature and extent of the costs of the Services, as required by 42 U.S.C. § 1395x(v)(1)(I).

14. Assignment.

Medical Director may not assign this Agreement or delegate the Services without Hospital's prior written consent. The Services are personal to Medical Director.

15. Governing Law.

This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Ohio, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules. Any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be brought exclusively in the state and federal courts sitting in Franklin County, Ohio.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.

RIDGELINE COMMUNITY HOSPITAL
